trips.summary: The most scenic trip I've done. Tawang, Sela Pass, and the Chinese border at Bumla.
story: Five of us, in and out through Guwahati. Dirang first, then up over Sela Pass to Tawang.
It is mountains, rivers, waterfalls and lakes the entire way, and the roads themselves are half the trip. Sela Lake sits right at the pass. Madhuri Lake further on, with yaks wandering around it.
We went up to Bumla Pass on the Chinese border, which was freezing. On the way we stopped at the war memorial and the old bunkers.
A lot of Maggi was eaten on the side of a mountain.
highlights: Bumla Pass, on the Chinese border

trips.summary: Ho Chi Minh, the Ha Giang loop on a bike, then Da Nang and Hoi An, with Anmol and Gaurav.
story: Two days in Ho Chi Minh to start: cafés, coffee, and walking the city without much of a plan.
Then Hanoi, and from there the Ha Giang loop. Three days on a bike through the mountains. Easily the most adventurous thing I've done on a trip.
Back to Hanoi, then down to Da Nang, with a day in Hoi An. Shopping, food, and the lanterns on the river at night.
I went with Anmol and Gaurav, who I worked with at Zomato.
highlights: The Ha Giang loop on a bike

trips.summary: Eight of us from the same college hostel, a few days of beaches, shacks and far too much beer.
story: This was the hostel group, eight or so of us, all crammed into the same trip. We spent most of it moving between beaches and the shacks behind them.
Not much of an itinerary. Beer, the sea, and the kind of long pointless conversations you only have with people you've lived with.
highlights: Going nowhere in particular with the hostel group

trips.summary: Phuket, Phi Phi, Krabi and Bangkok with Ishan, Harshpratap and Raja.
story: We worked our way down the coast: Phuket first, then Phi Phi, then Krabi, and finished in Bangkok.
The scuba at Phi Phi is the bit I still talk about. We saw a shark down there, which none of us were prepared for.
Bangkok was the other half of the trip: Safari World, the dolphin show, tigers up close, and a lot of nights out.
highlights: Scuba at Phi Phi, and the shark
Safari World and the dolphin show

trips.summary: Four of my Bengaluru flatmates, rented scooters, and a run of beaches along the cliff.
story: Same college hostel crowd, except by now we were flatmates in Bengaluru. We rented scooters on day one and barely got off them.
Beach to beach, beer in between, and a helipad near the cliff that turned out to be a great place to sit and do nothing.

trips.summary: A family trip with my parents and sister. Cold, green, and slow in the best way.
story: We stayed somewhere really nice and spent most of the time just looking at the hills. The weather stayed chilly the whole trip.
I went horse riding, which I had not done in years.
